roleLabel: Rush Vanguard — Max HP bruiser with Burn aura and Searing Mantra stuns
bestFor: Rush boards that want a high-HP frontliner who also spreads Burn while stunning the clump
strength: Inner Flame taxes adjacent enemies every second; Rush doubles it and Searing Mantra scales Burn with Rush count
weakness: Needs Rush uptime and adjacency — lonely wing placement wastes the aura

howToPlay.early: Strong opener tank/bruiser. Buy Max HP first so he lives on the point. Rush pieces matter as soon as you see them.
howToPlay.mid: Searing/Inner Flame path = personal Burn aura carry. Tempered = team Vanguard Max HP on Rush. Enlightened = longer Rush and temporary immunity windows. Choose tribal HP, Rush duration, or selfish Burn.
howToPlay.late: Stack Rush triggers and keep him adjacent to packs. Vanguard Aegis/Rally and Max HP engines beat random Magic.
howToPlay.positioning: Front row where enemies will stand next to him. Inner Flame is adjacent-only — empty neighbors mean empty damage.

abilityNotes.Searing Mantra: AoE smash that scales Burn with how many times Rush has triggered this game. More Rush relics make the cast scarier every fight.

specNotes.The Searing: Lean into Inner Flame / Burn aura identity — default when Ming is your Burn frontliner.
specNotes.The Tempered: Team Vanguard Max HP on Rush. Take with multiple Vanguards, not solo Ming greed.
specNotes.The Enlightened: Rush duration + immunity window. Take when Rush is already the run theme and you need him unkillable during the spike.

relicReasons.vanguards-rally-banner-538: Rush/rally tools feed both aura doubling and Mantra Burn stacks.
relicReasons.vanguards-aegis-banner-537: Keeps the Max HP frontliner alive on the engage tile.
relicReasons.vanguards-amplification-filigree-3005: Amplifies the Vanguard tag you drafted him for.

faq.question: Is Ming good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Excellent Rush frontliner. Mediocre if you never hit Rush thresholds or park him away from enemies. Buy him to hold and burn the line, not to snipe backline alone.

faq.question: What class is Ming?
faq.answer: Vanguard. Role focus: high-health Rush bruiser with adjacent Burn aura.

faq.question: What relics work with Ming?
faq.answer: Vanguard Rally/Aegis pieces, Rush amplifiers, and Max HP / defensive tools.

faq.question: How do you play Ming?
faq.answer: Front him into the pack, stack Max HP and Rush, cast Searing Mantra as Rush count climbs, and pick Tempered for tribal HP or Enlightened for Rush duration.

tips: Count adjacent tiles before combat — aura DPS is placement, not just stats.
Tempered without other Vanguards is usually worse than Searing/Enlightened.
